notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Fixed issues occurring in single-player mode.
Fixed a bug where the "Ready" button was missing in the lobby.

notes.title: Winter Update!
notes.content:
New Plane: Sakura!
Its guns may not have the longest range, but this plane excels at ramming enemies. Banzai!

New Air Combat Maps!
Take to the skies in new and exciting battle maps.

Random!
Now you can use random planes, spawn points and maps.

Improved Interface!
Enjoy a smoother and more intuitive user experience.

Bug Fixes!
We’ve addressed several issues to enhance gameplay stability and performance.

Update your game and dominate the skies!

notes.title: Game Release!
notes.content:
This is not a drill, recruits! You can now purchase the game and head into battle! There will be a launch discount, so don't forget to tell your friend!
An update is coming in November! Our command has promised to expand our fleet, allowing us to launch offensives on all fronts!
